title: Depth-three puncture H¹ vanishing
statement: For a Noetherian local ring R [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least three [def-weil-pbc-depth] and its punctured spectrum W [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], H^1(W,O_W), defined as Modules.H of the unit structure module, is subsingleton.

proof.text: Apply the punctured H¹ comparison theorem to the local-cohomology vanishing theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem depth_three_puncture_h_one
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := R) R)
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) :
    Subsingleton (Modules.H (X := W.toScheme)
      (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) 1)
